failure_summary.description: cells output is the natural input for downstream cell-cell communication / niche analysis but the handoff to spatial_omics_orchestrator is not documented

edits.content:
## Handoff to spatial_omics_orchestrator

When the user wants downstream cell-cell communication, niche detection,
or spatial domain analysis on the segmented cells, the handoff_manifest
should include:

```json
{
  "shapes_keys": ["tissues", "tiles", "cells", "cell_types"],
  "next_agent_hints": ["spatial_omics_orchestrator: pass wsi.shapes['cells'] as the cell-level GeoDataFrame; downstream can build neighbor graph via zs.pp.tile_graph or sklearn NearestNeighbors on cell centroids"]
}
```
